chain.title: Find the first draconium
chain.desc: Mine a supported draconium source and collect the dust. Check the pack's world generation and loot routes before making a large expedition solely for this material.

chain.title: Smelt the workshop material
chain.desc: Smelt draconium dust into ingots. Reserve the first batch for a core and fusion-crafting infrastructure rather than decorative blocks.

chain.title: A core for the first devices
chain.desc: Craft a Draconium Core. This shared component opens the energy, fusion, and equipment branches.

chain.title: A starting power option
chain.desc: Fuel a Generator and connect it to an energy consumer. Fusion recipes can need much more energy than an early generator supplies, so plan buffering or another compatible source.

chain.title: The center of fusion crafting
chain.desc: Place a Fusion Crafting Core with clear space for injectors. The core holds the central ingredient; surrounding injectors hold the other ingredients and receive energy.

chain.title: Arrange the first injectors
chain.desc: Build enough Basic Fusion Crafting Injectors for your selected recipe. Point them toward the core at a valid distance and provide each required ingredient and energy connection.

chain.title: Prepare Wyvern energy components
chain.desc: Craft a Wyvern Energy Core using the installed recipe. Keep these components available for equipment and the next fusion tier.

chain.title: A successful Wyvern fusion craft
chain.desc: Arrange the Wyvern Core recipe around the crafting core and supply the required energy. Confirm that every injector is valid before starting the process.

chain.title: Raise the injector tier
chain.desc: Upgrade the required injectors to Wyvern. Recipe tiers apply to the injectors holding ingredients; one upgraded injector does not upgrade the whole setup.

chain.title: A modular mining tool
chain.desc: Craft and charge a Wyvern Pickaxe. Install suitable modules and set its mining behavior before using it near finished construction.

chain.title: Build a configurable chestpiece
chain.desc: Craft and charge the Wyvern Chestpiece, then choose compatible energy and protection modules. The base item alone is not a complete defensive setup.

chain.title: Choose capabilities with modules
chain.desc: Make module components and consult the module recipes and tier limits. Build only the capabilities your current tool or chestpiece can accept.

chain.title: A crystal energy route
chain.desc: Link Energy Crystals using the supported tool and connection modes. Use input/output crystals where a machine connection is required; a relay connects the crystal network.

chain.title: Plan scalable energy storage
chain.desc: Build an Energy Core and follow the manual's structure for the selected tier, including stabilizers. Start with the capacity your power network can actually charge.

chain.title: Connect the storage structure
chain.desc: Build the required Energy Pylon arrangement and configure input or output. Verify transfer in both directions before treating the core as your workshop's reserve.

chain.title: Recover the dragon's heart
chain.desc: Defeat the Ender Dragon in its normal End fight and collect the Dragon Heart above the exit portal podium. Reserve it for awakening draconium; a summoned dragon may not produce one.
chain.acquisition: Dropped by code after the normal Ender Dragon fight: LootEventHandler.handleDragonDrops creates a Dragon Heart above the exit podium. Verified in 1.20 source and the 3.1.2.621 JAR bytecode; a summoned dragon without a fight manager is excluded.

chain.title: Awaken the draconium
chain.desc: Use the installed fusion recipe to awaken draconium with a Dragon Heart and the other ingredients. Ensure every participating injector meets the recipe tier.

chain.title: Prepare the awakened material
chain.desc: Convert an Awakened Draconium Block into ingots as needed. This material opens stronger equipment, injectors, and an optional reactor project.

chain.title: A core for Draconic equipment
chain.desc: Produce an Awakened Core through the installed fusion recipe. Plan the energy and injector layout before committing the ingredients.

chain.title: A Draconic fusion setup
chain.desc: Upgrade the fusion injectors for Draconic-tier recipes. Keep their energy routes clear and test one supported craft before rebuilding the whole workshop.

chain.title: Energy for stronger equipment
chain.desc: Craft a Draconic Energy Core for higher-tier devices and modules. Large storage is useful only when your network can recharge it between demanding jobs.

chain.title: Advance the mining branch
chain.desc: Upgrade to a Draconic Pickaxe and review its module arrangement and area settings. Equipment progression remains separate from the optional reactor branch.

chain.title: Prepare for the guardian journey
chain.desc: Upgrade the chestpiece and fit an appropriate, charged module loadout. Review mobility, protection, and escape options before approaching a chaos island.

chain.title: Defeat the Chaos Guardian
chain.desc: Find a chaos island in the End and defeat its guardian. Prepare a charged equipment loadout and understand the encounter mechanics before committing to the fight.

chain.title: Claim the chaos resource
chain.desc: After the guardian encounter, recover the chaos resource using the supported method and leave the unstable island area. Keep the resulting shards for the planned Chaotic recipes.

chain.title: Craft a Chaotic Core
chain.desc: Complete the Chaotic Core fusion recipe with the required shards, ingredients, and energy. Check recipe tiers carefully; a Draconic workshop needs a planned upgrade path.

chain.title: The final injector tier
chain.desc: Upgrade the necessary injectors to Chaotic tier. Higher-tier recipes still require the full ingredient layout and enough delivered energy.

chain.title: Plan a separate reactor project
chain.desc: Craft the reactor core and study the complete operating procedure before assembly. It needs stabilizers, an injector, containment power, fuel, and controlled energy flow; it is not required for the tool branch.

chain.title: Complete the reactor's supporting systems
chain.desc: Prepare the full stabilizer and injector arrangement shown by the manual. Establish containment supply, output control, monitoring, and shutdown behavior before activating the assembled reactor.

chain.title: Build the combined endgame tool
chain.desc: Craft the Chaotic Staff of Power, charge it, and fit the modules you intend to use. Check area and combat settings before using it around your base.

notes: Re-reviewed 2026-10-07 against local Minecraft 1.20.1 JAR item assets and selected recipes/manuals, with official project sources listed separately. This replaces older list-order and item-count claims.

coverage.scope: Authored branched progression; item and component acquisition objectives, not automatic proof that a factory works.
limits: Verified item assets against cached 3.1.2.621 and installed 3.1.2.604 for Minecraft 1.20.1.
Boss strategy, all module recipes, and operating reactor control designs are not fully specified by this guide.
Pack scripts, recipe changes, and other Minecraft versions require the installed-pack scan; this guide is not a complete mod manual.
